title: Currency Conversion Kiosk
code:
dollars_for_euro = 1.2
commission = 3
euro = 100

dollars = euro * dollars_for_euro - commission
print("For", euro, "euros you will get", dollars, "dollars")

lines.explanation: Assigning the float value '1.2' to the variable 'dollars_for_euros'. Ths specifies the ratio of rates of euros to the dollar.
Assigning the integer value '3' to the variable 'commission'. This specifies the commission charges.
Assigning the integer value '100' to the variable 'euros'. This specifies the number of euros to be converted.
This is a simple Arithmetic operation to convert euros to dollar. It also considers the commission rate.

lines.code: print("For", euro, "euros you will get", dollars, "dollars")
lines.explanation: This statement prints out the dollars you will receive in return when you give 100 euros.
